payload.description: Catalogue at docs/diagrams/README.md — 30 diagrams in four families (arch / pipeline / mech / series) serving two audiences: the basecamp+standalone packaging work, and the forum post series. Includes conventions carried from the post-1 figures, a provenance/manifest drift mechanism modelled on ADR-012, and a five-tranche build order. Open questions in §5 need a decision before tranche 1.
payload.title: Diagram programme: architecture + pipeline figures

payload.body: Plan updated with the assembly interactive substrate (logos-co/assembly basecamp-stack-preview). Decisions taken: (1) consolidate to docs/diagrams/ with slug names, retire figN-; (2) provenance block + manifest.json with two CI checks; (3) reuse the substrate engine — static figures become exported frames rather than separately authored artefacts. Blocking correctness issue found in the upstream diagram: the network layer advertises 'mix' as shipped and the messaging view is titled 'Encrypted chat over the mixnet', but LOGOS-MIXNET is status raw, send-only PoC, not on the near-term roadmap. Must be fixed before forking; worth raising upstream. Sequencing now starts with a tranche 0 of foundations.

payload.body: Tranche 0 complete. Five post-1 figures moved to docs/diagrams/ with slug names (supporting-material §8 updated). manifest.json + tools/check-manifest.py with a diagram-manifest pre-commit hook; all four failure modes verified to fire (missing source FAILs, changed source WARNs non-fatally, bad vocabulary FAILs, unlisted figure FAILs). Provenance blocks are GENERATED from the manifest via --stamp, and the check rejects a block that drifts from its entry, so provenance cannot be maintained in two places. Substrate forked to docs/diagrams/substrate-stack.html: re-skinned to prototype tokens, six views, mix and muster-module both shown as not shipped, plus a dark 'beyond your device' band naming the observers. tools/export-frames.mjs generates six static frames, verified as XML and rendered through librsvg; exporter is idempotent. Two real bugs found and fixed in the process: marker fills can't be reached by descendant selectors (every arrowhead was grey, upstream has this too), and a <svg> inside a CSS comment breaks XML parsing of an exported frame (now CDATA-wrapped unconditionally).

payload.description: Static SVG. One running standalone instance: core process, capability_module, chat_module (embeds libchat), delivery_module (embeds a Waku node), lez_core (embeds wallet-ffi), the isolated ui-host process, the QtRO seam, per-instance state dirs, and the two live remote dependencies crossing the boundary. Establishes the box names the keystone draws from. docs/diagrams/README.md tranche 1.
